workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, thanks for checking. I've cross-referenced your proposed slots with Priya's and Marcus's calendars, and unfortunately, none of those times work for them either. It seems we're running out of options.

To make sure we find a time, could you please send me the full list of busy times for both Elena and David for next week? That way I can do a full comparison of all four calendars and find a time that works for everyone.

Thanks,
Alison
